import json, subprocess, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import check
payload=open('/app/work/big64.jsonl','rb').read()
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/app/submission/planner.py'],input=payload,capture_output=True)
dt=time.time()-t0
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall',round(dt,2),'s  stdout bytes',len(p.stdout))
lines=p.stdout.decode().splitlines()
reqs=[json.loads(l) for l in payload.decode().splitlines()]
print('lines',len(lines))
stats={}; fails=0; worst=0
for req,line in zip(reqs,lines):
    r=json.loads(line); stats[r['status']]=stats.get(r['status'],0)+1
    errs=check.check(req,r,verbose=False)
    if errs: fails+=1; print('FAIL',errs[:3])
print('stats',stats,'fails',fails)
print('per-line avg', round(dt/len(lines),3),'s')
print('stderr',p.stderr.decode()[:300])
"
